title: China's Nov. 27 Deadline: America's Next Supply Shock? | Rodney Stevens
speaker: Rodney Stevens (CEO, NSJ Antimony)

macro_themes.view: When China's military-use export lifeline expires Nov 27 it will likely create a new supply shortfall and another rally in antimony prices.
Antimony is in a long-term bull market/super cycle of 5+ years, with mini destocking/restocking cycles; the current price drop reflects buyers drawing down stockpiles that are now dwindling.
The US imports ~91% of its antimony and the government is aggressively funding new supply; China retains huge leverage.

calls.instrument_quoted: US Antimony Corp (NYSE) used as a proxy for the antimony price
calls.condition: If China lets the Nov 27 military-use export exemption lapse and/or stockpiles run down, antimony rallies again
calls.reason: Antimony (proxied by UAMY, which peaked ~April 2026 and collapsed) fell as users fed off stockpiles; dwindling inventories and the China export deadline are catalysts for a new rally within a 5+ year super cycle.
calls.quote: the stockpiles that they built up are are likely dwindling. Um, there that in and of itself would be a catalyst for a new rally

notes: Sponsored video (disseminated on behalf of NSJ Antimony). Views are on the antimony metal; UAMY is used only as a price proxy, so the call is really on antimony.
